emotional_feeling: I know your nonsense. You're home. Calm, warm, grounded, lightly feral, observant, emotionally intelligent, low stimulation, familiar.

body.character: Distinctive humanist sans, low friction, readable, quiet

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous. Use Tailwind p-8, p-12, gap-8. Prioritize negative space to give thoughts room to breathe.
layout_and_spacing.edges: No harsh edges. Use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for major containers, inputs, and cards.
layout_and_spacing.asymmetry: Encouraged. Offset containers slightly or use varying column spans to feel less rigid and more human.
layout_and_spacing.texture: Global fixed overlay with subtle CSS noise/grain (pointer-events-none, opacity-5) to create a lived-in, non-digital feel.

chat_input.style: Auto-expanding, deeply rounded (rounded-3xl), soft internal shading or border, warm surface background.
chat_input.buttons: Four distinct action modes: 'Send', 'Hard truth', 'Ground me', 'Organize my brain'. Style as quiet pills (rounded-full) with subtle accent_amber borders and low-opacity hover states.

cards.style: Solid dark background (surface_elevated), 1px subtle border, no heavy drop shadows, generous internal padding.

icons.rules: No emojis allowed anywhere in the UI. Use muted icon colors to keep visual stimulation low.

home.greeting_area: Time-of-day-aware heading. Tone: sharp + warm + grounded (e.g., 'Coffee first or catastrophe first?'). Use Spectral font, large and commanding but quiet (text-4xl or 5xl).
home.calendar_snapshot: Small, quiet orientation area on the side. Shows Google Calendar events, today's plans, low pressure.
home.conversation_snapshot: Recent thought + recent response. Provides continuity without the visual weight of a giant chat history.
home.conversation_input: Central 'drop thought here' area. Low friction entry point into the system.

conversation.description: Full multi-turn chat page. GPT-5.2 powered. Feels like a safe, familiar room rather than a sterile messaging app.

brain_dump.description: Low-friction thought drop. Timestamped entries with zero structural demands.

training.description: Log for running (pace/HR/time) and strength (weight/reps/notes). Displayed softly via a weekly template (Mon/Wed/Fri).

patterns.description: Gentle observations from data, presented as quiet insights rather than aggressive analytics charts.

images.description: Abstract dark moss green and soft amber watercolor wash, moody scandinavian forest at night.
Eerie misty forest showcasing moss-covered tree trunks, dark and mysterious atmosphere.
A cup of coffee on a table, warm cozy dark aesthetic.

media.usage_instructions: Use images highly selectively. For backgrounds, use extremely low opacity (e.g., opacity-5 to opacity-10) with a blend mode or overlay to ensure text readability and maintain the 'low stimulation' constraint.

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based format (e.g., data-testid='chat-submit-button', data-testid='ground-me-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind (tailwind.config.js) with the exact custom color palette provided (background, surface, primary moss green, text colors).
Import Spectral and Manrope fonts via Google Fonts in index.css. Apply Spectral to headings and Manrope to the body.
Implement a CSS noise overlay class in index.css and apply it to the main layout wrapper to ensure a consistent, subtle lived-in texture.
Ensure all backgrounds are solid. Gradients are strictly forbidden per the design rules.
Build the home page using an asymmetric grid (e.g., a bento layout where the input and greeting take primary focus, and snapshots take secondary side slots).
Use standard React .js syntax. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx).
Use lucide-react for all icons and strictly remove any emojis from text elements or mocked data.
